title: Guess the Number Judge
description: The secret number is `37` and the player has 5 tries. Read guesses (one per line). Ignore any line that is not a whole number (it does not use a try). For each valid guess print `low`, `high` or `correct`. Stop after `correct` (print `Won in <n> tries`) or after 5 valid tries (print `Lost`).

solution_code:
secret = 37
max_tries = 5
tries = 0
won = False
while tries < max_tries:
    text = input().strip()
    if not text.lstrip('-').isdigit():
        continue
    guess = int(text)
    tries += 1
    if guess < secret:
        print('low')
    elif guess > secret:
        print('high')
    else:
        print('correct')
        won = True
        break
print(f'Won in {tries} tries' if won else 'Lost')
